messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update the existing playable game to add difficulty-scaled stamina, prevent enemy overlap, increase enemy attack frequency, remove attack-induced enemy stun, strengthen boss missions, add three stages to the Chapter 2 boss, improve the Chapter 1 aircraft battleground, and improve character models.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.
- User requested screenshots for checks: small JPEG, viewport at most 1280px wide; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Scale stamina capacity and recovery by difficulty: Easy 1.25×, Normal 1×, Hard 0.78×.
- Increase enemy health and power in boss missions; increase Chapter 2 boss phase health.
- Remove stun effects from player attacks and RALLY.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added difficulty-scaled stamina and recovery values; character selection cards refresh displayed stats when difficulty changes.
- Changed Chapter 2 boss health to `[620,820,1080]` and updated its briefing to describe a three-stage encounter.
- Increased boss-mission enemy strength and shortened enemy attack cooldowns.
- Removed stun effects caused by player attacks and RALLY.
- Added enemy separation/repacking and movement bounds to keep enemies from overlapping.
- Improved Chapter 1 cabin background with overhead lockers, cabin service lights, and added seat detail.

### Active
- Improve character model details; an edit to `drawFighter` failed because the exact source text did not match.
- Verify all changes for runtime issues, run the game, and capture/inspect a current JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Character model enhancement edit was blocked by exact-string mismatch. No other known blockers.

## Next Move
1. Inspect current `game.js` around `drawFighter` hands/torso and make a targeted model-detail edit that matches existing text.
2. Run the game and check for JS/runtime or gameplay regressions, especially stamina UI updates, three boss phases, enemy spacing, and attack cadence.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.
4. Check the git diff and leave changes uncommitted unless the user requests otherwise.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: game stages, difficulty, combat, rendering, and enemy behavior.
- `index.html`: game canvas and interface structure.
- `style.css`: game layout and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Chapter 2’s final stage uses `waves:[2,2,1,1,1]`, `bossPhases:3`; its three final waves each include a boss, with phase determined by `bossPhase()`.
- Existing model code is in `drawFighter`; attempted edit failed with an exact-string mismatch and made no change.
- No screenshot or test run has been completed yet.

## Objective
- Improve the existing playable game with difficulty-scaled stamina, stronger and better-spaced enemies, upgraded boss encounters, a more recognizable aircraft cabin, and enhanced character models.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For checks, save a small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Scale stamina capacity and recovery by difficulty: Easy 1.25×, Normal 1×, Hard 0.78×.
- Increase enemy health and power in boss missions; increase Chapter 2 boss phase health.
- Remove stun effects caused by player attacks and RALLY.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added difficulty-scaled stamina and recovery; character selection cards refresh displayed stats when difficulty changes.
- Set Chapter 2 boss health to `[620,820,1080]` and configured three final boss phases.
- Increased boss-mission enemy strength and shortened enemy attack cooldowns.
- Removed stun effects caused by player attacks and RALLY; updated RALLY briefing text.
- Added enemy separation and movement bounds to prevent overlap.
- Added overhead lockers, cabin service lights, and seat details to the aircraft cabin.
- Enhanced fighter models with facial features, clothing seams, insignia, and enemy gear details.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` completed successfully.

### Active
- Run browser/runtime and gameplay checks, especially stamina UI, three boss phases, enemy spacing, and attack cadence.
- Save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
- Review the final diff.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the running game in a browser and check for runtime errors and gameplay regressions.
2. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.
3. Review the diff and report verification; leave changes uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: stage configuration, difficulty, combat, enemy behavior, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Chapter 2’s final stage uses `waves:[2,2,1,1,1]` and `bossPhases:3`; its three final waves each include a boss.
- Changes are uncommitted; `game.js` is modified.
